subject: FK edges into excluded tables (1460 census relationships)
decision: Tables in the shared_postgresql and orm_framework buckets (table_buckets.json, 379 excluded via --exclude-table) stay in PostgreSQL. Every FK column from a migrated collection into one of them (create_uid, write_uid, company_id, currency_id, partner_id, ...) remains a plain integer field holding the PostgreSQL id, resolved by the ORM across stores; edges between two excluded tables are not modeled. model_patch.py --check at 9a584b4 still reports these edges as 'no rationale row' because it consults modeling.excluded (the exclude decision) and not modeling.excluded_tables (the proposer's --exclude-table list): reported as a plugin gap on UNT12-9, not patched.

subject: kpi_provider.get_kpi_summary runs without a registry (NOTES.md s2.3 row 23, blocked)
decision: Model-side answer: no spec change. The KPI query reads account_move.state, account_move.review_state, account_move.journal_id, account_move.statement_line_id, account_journal.type and account_bank_statement_line.is_reconciled; all six stay top-level fields of the accountMove, accountJournal and accountBankStatementLine collections (none is embedded), so the HTTP-layer endpoint can run the same filters as one aggregation on accountMove with $lookup on accountJournal and accountBankStatementLine, no registry needed. The information_schema probe that guards it becomes a check that the three collections exist. Until that rewrite ships, the endpoint returns [] (its own 'module not installed' path) once account_move leaves PostgreSQL; the PG id shadow cannot serve it because it has no state/journal columns.

evidence.note: manager s3.1 note (3): propose a model-side answer for the blocked register items, no ORM code

subject: stock post_init_hook reads product_product.qty_available raw (NOTES.md s2.3 row 28, blocked)
decision: Model-side answer: no spec change. _create_inventory_adjustment reads the pre-stock stored JSONB column product_product.qty_available at `-i stock` time only. Keep product_product readable on the PostgreSQL side until stock is installed: in the wave plan product_product opts into MongoDB only after stock is installed on the target database (fresh installs: install stock before the product unit migrates), so the hook always finds the column in PostgreSQL. For databases where product_product is already Mongo-backed, the hook's query returns no rows against the id shadow (the shadow keeps id only) and the inventory adjustment is skipped, which is the hook's own behaviour on a database without stored quantities. The productProduct collection does not need a qty_available field: with stock installed the field is computed from stock_quant.

evidence.note: manager s3.1 note (3): keep product_product readable through the id shadow or the PG side; no ORM code
